trailhead.label: Sils/Segl Maria car park, the board’s start

cautions: Rocky and rooty forest path on the peninsula.
Steep banks down to the lake on the peninsula: keep your dog on a lead near the water.
Hay meadows on the plain are closed from 1 June until the hay harvest: keep to the track.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
